facts: The petition is on behalf of the Storm Water Drains Beldars (SWD Beldars) and Storm Water Drains Mates (SWD Mates) who are Class IV employees in the service of the New Delhi Municipal Committee (NDMC).
The short question for our consideration is whether the SWD Beldars and SWD Mates are entitled to the pay scales recommended by the Shiv Shanker Committee (the SS Committee)?

It is not necessary to go into the factual details as the same have been covered in R.D. Gupta case (1987) 4 SCC 505: 1987 SCC (L and S) 470: (1987) 5 ATC 65: (1987) 3 SCR 808 1987 Indlaw SC 28301 and Narendra Kumar case.

The technical staff of the Delhi Electric Supply Undertaking (DESU) were not satisfied with the pay scales granted as a result of the recommendations of the Third Pay Commission and they demanded higher pay scales.
The Government, therefore, constituted the SS Committee to go into the question of revision of pay scales of the technical staff of DESU.
issues: Whether the SWD Beldars and SWD Mates are entitled to the pay scales recommended by the Shiv Shanker Committee (the SS Committee)?
petitioner_arguments: The petitioners have pleaded in paras 4, 5 and 6 of the writ petition as under:...

It is stated that the duty of SWD Beldars is to scavenge and desalt the dirt and filth from the covered storm water drains constructed and maintained by Respondent 1 within its territorial jurisdiction.
The categories connected with the work of maintaining cleanliness of roads, sewerage system and storm water drains were known as 'Sweeper and Allied Categories'.
Prior to 1978, SWD Beldars and SWD Mates were appointed in the same manner in which the employees belonging to sweepers and allied categories used to be appointed.
respondent_arguments: With reference to paragraph Nos. 3 to 7 of the petition it is submitted that storm water drains beldar hereinafter called SWD Beldar, are in the pay scales of Rs 750-940; whereas SWD Mates are in pay scale of Rs 800-1150, which is the promotional post.
court_reasoning: The precise question for our consideration, therefore, is whether the petitioners before us belong to the same class to which the SS Committee pay scales have already been granted by the NDMC.
A 'Beldar' is essentially a Safai Karamchari.
There are beldars under different nomenclature in the service of the NDMC.

The petitioners have pleaded that the duty of SWD Beldars is to scavenge and desalt the dirt and filth from the covered storm water drains constructed and maintained by Respondent 1 within its territorial jurisdiction.
holding: The Court held that the SWD Beldars and SWD Mates are entitled to the pay scales recommended by the Shiv Shanker Committee (the SS Committee).
